host.description: IP address to bind the server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

port.description: TCP port to listen on (standard Gopher port is 70).

gopher_root.description: Absolute filesystem path to the Gopher content root directory.

user.description: Unix username to drop privileges to after binding to the port.

group.description: Unix group name to drop privileges to after binding to the port.

directory_index.description: If enabled, automatically generate a directory index when a directory is requested and no gophermap is present.

syslog.description: If enabled, log to the system syslog facility; otherwise, log to stderr (useful for containerized deployments).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. A connection is closed if no request is received within this time.

charset.description: Default character set advertised in the server response header (e.g., 'UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1').

gophermap_fallback.description: Fallback mode for rendering directory listings when a gophermap is missing: 'none' (no listing), 'text' (plain text), or 'html' (HTML-formatted listing).

path_prefix.description: Optional path prefix prepended to all requested paths (e.g., '/gopher' for reverse-proxy setups).

log_client_ip.description: If enabled, include client IP addresses in access logs (may affect privacy).

mime_type.description: MIME type to associate with files having this extension.

mime_overrides.description: Dictionary mapping file extensions to MIME types (for use in INFO type 9 responses).

access_rules.description: List of IP/network allow/deny rules. Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins.

root.description: Alternative filesystem path to serve for this host.

virtual_hosts.description: List of virtual hosts, mapping hostname to content root directory.
